title: Why Your Food Tastes Different When You Hold Your Nose
hook: Why does your favourite food taste bland with a blocked nose?

narration.text: Your sense of taste dramatically changes if you pinch your nose while eating.
Taste buds on your tongue only detect five basic tastes: sweet, sour, salty, bitter, and umami.
The complex flavours we enjoy actually come from our sense of smell.
When you chew, food releases aromas into your nasal cavity, connecting with your brain.
Try it now: eat a familiar food, like a crisp, while holding your nose.
You will notice a much simpler, less nuanced flavour.
Comment if you tried it and what you noticed, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more brain hacks.

description: Ever wondered why food tastes different when you have a cold? It is all down to how your senses of taste and smell work together. Find out the surprising reason behind this everyday phenomenon.
topic: Why your perception of taste changes if you hold your nose while eating. Try eating a familiar food with your nose pinched.
